method: Primary-source names and matching government offices establish these variants. Names alone do not establish authorship or X account ownership.

aliases.basis: The Senate hearing names Stephen A. Feinberg, Deputy Secretary of Defense nominee. His department biography names Steve Feinberg in the same office.
DIA identifies its director as Lieutenant General James H. Adams, USMC. The prepared statement names Director, Defense Intelligence Agency, LT. GEN. JAMES ADAMS, USMC.
The official biography explicitly names Mr. Jules (Jay) W. Hurst.
